tasks.objective: Make MemoryStore validate trusted memory on read, in src/neural_node_swarm/memory.py only. Add a module-level validate_event(event) that checks a stored record against the packaged memory_event.schema.json (load it, node_output.schema.json and verifier_result.schema.json via importlib.resources from src/neural_node_swarm/schemas/ and resolve the relative $refs with a referencing.Registry keyed by each schema's $id; cache the validator), re-runs verify_node_output on event["output"] and requires status passed, requires the stored verifier_result to equal the recomputed one, and requires event["step_id"] == output["step_id"]. On any failure raise VerificationError (from verifier.py). MemoryStore.events() and read_refs() must run validate_event on every record, for both JSONL and storage backends, and raise instead of returning anything when a record is invalid. Test by appending real events, then tampering the JSONL file and the SQLite payload directly.
success_criteria: Records written by MemoryStore.append still read back unchanged on both the JSONL and SQLite backends
A record whose output carries a notes field, edited into the stored log after the write, makes events() and read_refs() raise VerificationError on both backends and nothing is returned
A record whose output objective, verifier_result status, round (e.g. 7) or event_id field was edited, or that gained an extra top-level key, makes events() raise VerificationError
A record that still passes the memory-event schema but whose stored verifier_result no longer matches the recomputed one is rejected
The new test file fails on the starting commit and the full suite passes after the change
constraints: Edit only src/neural_node_swarm/memory.py plus one new test file named for the item, e.g. tests/test_validate_on_read_w2t1.py; task 2 adds src/neural_node_swarm/replay.py and task 3 edits orchestrator.py and adds governed_runtime.py, so do not touch those
Do not change any schema file; src/neural_node_swarm/schemas/ must stay byte-identical to schemas/
Keep MemoryStore(path), MemoryStore(storage=...), id_source, clock and the duplicate-ID rejection working so every existing test passes
Do not add runtime dependencies; jsonschema and referencing are already available

tasks.objective: Add replayable runtime runs in a new module src/neural_node_swarm/replay.py. Provide counter_id_source(prefix="evt") and stepping_clock(start, step) helpers that return fresh deterministic callables for MemoryStore's id_source and clock, and replay_run(log_path, node_factory, *, id_source, clock, node_id="node-1") which reads the recorded JSONL log as raw bytes, takes the start objective from the first record's objective field, re-runs Orchestrator.run with node_factory into a fresh JSONL MemoryStore in a temporary directory using the given (fresh) id_source and clock, and compares the two files byte for byte. It returns a dict with status "replayed" or "diverged", the event counts, and the index of the first differing line (None if identical). Test with a deterministic node (e.g. DisposableNode): an untouched log replays; logs edited after the run (changed output field, changed recorded_at, dropped line, appended line) are diverged.
success_criteria: A relay run through Orchestrator.run with counter_id_source and stepping_clock is replayed from its log with status replayed and a byte-identical event stream
Each post-run modification of the log (changed output field, changed recorded_at, removed line, appended line) is reported as diverged with the first differing line index
replay_run reads the original log as raw bytes rather than through MemoryStore.events(), and never writes to the original log
No randomness, wall clock, network or model call is used by replay_run or its tests
The new test file fails on the starting commit and the full suite passes after the change
constraints: Only add src/neural_node_swarm/replay.py and one new test file named for the item, e.g. tests/test_runtime_replay_w2t2.py; do not edit any existing file, including memory.py, orchestrator.py and __init__.py, which other tasks this wave edit
Use only the public MemoryStore(path, id_source=..., clock=...) and Orchestrator(memory, node_factory).run(objective, node_id=...) APIs, whose signatures will not change this wave
A parallel task makes MemoryStore.events() raise on tampered records, so the divergence check must compare raw file bytes and must not depend on events() accepting a modified log

Add Orchestrator.run_governed_chain(objective, *, node_factory, gate, node_count) to orchestrator.py: like run_chain, but each successor is built with node_factory(node_id, gate.reader()) and gets no MemoryStore or InheritanceStore handle. Add run_runtime_poisoning(db_path, memory, *, poisoned, evidence_fault, successors=6) that commits the hand/leg candidates and host evidence of poisoning_experiment.run_persistent_promotion through the gate, runs successors via run_governed_chain, which record reads in valid node outputs, and returns reads plus wrong_successor_reads, correct_successor_reads and abstentions.

Each successor's three rounds are committed to the MemoryStore as valid node outputs, and existing run, run_chain and poisoning tests still pass
